description:
t3:perf cannot compare: the baseline is timing method 1 (missing run.timing_method means legacy), DuckDB results are method 2 since PR #4080. Rebuild the baseline under method 2 with the documented procedure (docs/internal/perf-smoke.md "Refreshing the baseline": several runs, same runner class, never one run), recompute both noise floors with the documented 1.25x rule, and make scripts/perf_smoke_baseline.py reject sources whose timing methods differ or are missing, recording the method in the baseline.

Inputs: t3-perf-result artifacts of nightly runs 43254687916, 43453477982, 43604460150, 43726725879, 43916000915 (gh run download). Update the .sources.json ledger.

Scope: _project/baselines/perf_smoke_duckdb_tpch_001*.json, scripts/perf_smoke_baseline.py, tests/unit/scripts/test_perf_smoke_baseline.py, docs/internal/perf-smoke.md, and the compare thresholds in .github/workflows/nightly-v2.yml only if the recomputed floors differ.
